gaps: Massachusetts has no local general sales tax; the 6.25% state rate applies everywhere.
272 of the 351 cities and towns have adopted the local option meals excise ("meals_local", 0.75%) on restaurant meals.

Cities and towns are county subdivisions, many of them not Census places, so the meals excise is given per tract as well ("tracts", 1551 tracts in adopting towns): each tract takes the town that holds most of its blocks.
The state also taxes restaurant meals at 6.25%; local room-occupancy and cannabis excises are not included.
Adopting towns that hold no tract majority (small towns sharing a tract) are not recorded: blandford, buckland, charlemont, chilmark, gill, leverett, newashford, sunderland
